    def improve(routes, dists, total_dist, max_dist):

                            new_cost = distance_matrix[route[i-1], route[k]] + distance_matrix[route[i], route[k+1]]
                            if new_cost < old_cost - 1e-12:
                                route[i:k+1] = route[i:k+1][::-1]
